title: Reduction is bijective on morphisms of finite etale algebras
statement: Let $(R,\mathfrak m,\kappa)$ be a henselian local ring [def-weil-pbc-henselian-terminology] and S,T finite etale R-algebras [def-weil-etale-morphism]. Reduction gives a bijection from R-algebra homomorphisms S to T to kappa-algebra homomorphisms $\kappa\otimes_R S$ to $\kappa\otimes_R T$.

proof.text: Decompose only the target T as a finite product of finite henselian local R-algebras A_i using 04GH. Transport formal etaleness along the decomposition and apply Mathlib Algebra.FormallyEtale.pi_iff to see that each A_i is formally unramified over R.

For every target factor A_i, reduction is bijective on R-algebra maps S to A_i. This uses the local-target comparison, which lifts residue points by the unique etale retraction property after base change to A_i.

Let k be the residue field of R. Tensor the target decomposition with k and compose with Mathlib Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight to obtain e_0 : k tensor_R T isomorphic to product_i (k tensor_R A_i). Tensor induction proves that applying e_0 to the reduction of f and projecting at i equals reducing the i-th component of e composed with f. Injectivity follows by applying the local injectivity to each coordinate, function extensionality, and injectivity of e. For surjectivity project the given reduced map into each factor, lift its components by local surjectivity, combine them with AlgHom.pi, and compose with e inverse. The same tensor identity and injectivity of e_0 prove that its reduction is the given map. Empty target products obey the same argument without a case split.

proof_origin.place: Tags 04GK (full faithfulness), 04GH (1),(2), and 04GG (8). Shorter local-target proof assembled by Q1 from these results; no tensor-factor classification or Nakayama comparison is used.
